instruction: A cinematic still captured from a slightly low angle in a medium shot. On an outdoor wooden boardwalk with a metal railing, surrounded by lush green trees, four friends are interacting. On the left, the man in the orange t-shirt (R2) stands in profile facing right, shaking hands with the man in the grey t-shirt (R4) who stands on the right facing left. Between them, the woman in the beige hoodie (R1) stands facing right with a smile, while the woman in the grey hijab (R3) stands second from the right, laughing as she watches the handshake. Bright, warm sunlight filters through the canopy, creating a backlit effect with a warm color palette.
elements: R2 and R4 are the handshaking contact pair
